objective: Repair dropped Arena attack/skill input during movement; add playable offline class effects, temporary pickups, visual/audio feedback and explicit game documentation.
productionBaselineEvidence: Derived only from existing Empire Arena cinematic DEV branch; main and live APK not edited. Exact production deployed artifact not checked and must not be inferred.
chosenApproach: Standalone HTML practice and deterministic no-account engine; retain original licensed embedded media and deliberately avoid native/backend/deployment writes.
selectionRationale: Keep minimum fix scoped to user-observed issue while delivering real verified practice gameplay and preserving live account/financial safety.
alternativeApproaches: Godot/native release deferred until dedicated signed staging APK and graphics/device acceptance.
Networked ranked play deferred until trusted authoritative match service and transactional settlement.
acceptanceChecks: Queued Attack/Skill succeeds while moving/capturing, with out-of-range assist and clear feedback.
Every archetype has a visibly receipted skill; all 13 heroes usable with shared legal placeholder animations.
Temporary health/shield/Flux pickups never grant permanent economy value.
Landscape/camera, three maps, HUD labels, sound cues and minimap remain playable offline.
preserveBehaviors: Existing Kingdom and original 13-station map remain untouched.
BP, QMP, Character Diamonds, cash and permanent inventory never modified.
